fixInstructions: Fix 1: two-phase protocol implemented (adapt_q=True path): Phase-1 accepted draws collected only for adaptation (q = KAPPA0*(0.25+0.75*accepted_mean/accepted_mean.max())), discarded, Phase 2 fixed-q retains only Phase-2 draws; lo90/hi90/mean/cv from Phase 2 only; per-week eff_retention + phase1_discarded reported in weekly_diagnostics.csv; default adapt_q=False freezes q from the first draw so all retained draws are iid.

Fix 2 (option a): v0-recentering removed; fixed judge-informed prior q_i = KAPPA0*exp(theta*s_i)/sum(exp(theta*s_j)) with theta=6.0, KAPPA0=12.0 for all weeks; pipeline fully re-run; CI widths grew from mean 0.117 to 0.241, CV 0.333 to 0.725.

Fix 3: feasible() now accepts order_pairs/is_finale and enforces c[i] >= c[j]-TOL for all ordering pairs per batch row, matching feasible_single; point estimate additionally uses an explicit ordering penalty plus deterministic bubble-sort fallback.

Fix 4 (option a): results_summary.md 'Model Parameters' rewritten to describe the actual truncated-Dirichlet rejection-sampling model; all Metropolis-within-Gibbs / hierarchical-logit claims deleted; the hierarchical extension is listed as an unimplemented limitation instead.

Fix 5: V1 prior-lift statistics (P(correct elimination): mean 0.3409, median 0.1917, min 0.0 over 264 elimination weeks; lift ~2.9x) and V3 rule-sensitivity counts (21/254 S3+ weeks = 8.3% rule-disagreement) now headline the summary; repl_prob demoted to a sampler-correctness footnote and the >=0.85 forward-test claim retracted.

Fix 6: dead lines removed from model1_core.py; pipeline re-run; weekly_panel.csv row-identical to revision 1 (diff clean), fan_votes_point.csv unchanged in distribution (margin mean 1.3432 -> 1.3367, Nelder-Mead path identical, RNG split makes it deterministic), the two posterior CSVs intentionally differ (fix 1-3 change the posterior by design).
